releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.28

Cloud sync
- Live sync while the app is open and not playing: a change on one device shows up on
  the others within a second, without the constant churn a always-on listener would
  cause during playback.
- Switch between cloud accounts, or add another, without inheriting someone else's
  Continue Watching. Clearing a device now keeps a local copy you can restore.
- Sign in with Google on the desktop app.

Series
- Continue Watching now opens the same full player as the show page (next/previous
  episode, auto-next, Up next).
- Previous / Next episode buttons in the player.
- Hold an episode to mark it watched or unwatched, on the show page or in the player.
- Episode rows show the episode's own name and a watched tick instead of a repeated
  show title.

Subtitles
- The season and episode boxes are filled in from what is actually playing.
- When a Spanish title finds nothing, the search retries with the real English release
  title, which is what the subtitle index is filed under.

Also: show/hide password on sign-in, and a clearer message when an account does not
exist yet.
